confidentialite.metaDescription: What data data-dz collects, why, who can access it and how to exercise your rights.
confidentialite.resume: no data is required to browse or download datasets. If you create an account, we keep the minimum needed to sign you in and show your profile. No advertising, no data selling.

sections.texte:
The data-dz website is run by the **New Algeria** project ([newalgeria.org](https://newalgeria.org)).

For any question about your data: [newalgeria.org@gmail.com](mailto:newalgeria.org@gmail.com).

Only to let you sign in (including sending you confirmation and password reset emails) and to show your public profile.

**No advertising, no data selling, no profiling.**

On your public page (`/members/your-username`), anyone can see your username, display name, bio, website, avatar, sign-up date and, where applicable, your moderator or administrator role.

**Your email address is never shown.**

**No advertising or tracking cookies.**

The website only keeps in your browser (local storage) what it needs to work: your sign-in session and the language you chose.
Your account data is kept as long as your account exists. When you ask for its deletion, we delete your account, your profile and your avatar.

conditions.metaDescription: The rules for using data-dz: free access to data, licences, accounts, published content and limits of liability.
conditions.resume: the data is free to access, the service is free and provided without warranty, each dataset keeps its source's licence, and everyone is responsible for what they publish.

sections.texte:
data-dz is a **free and open source** portal of data about Algeria, run **on a volunteer basis** by the [New Algeria](https://newalgeria.org) project.

The service may change, be modified or be interrupted at any time.

Browsing and downloading data is **free and requires no account**.

An account lets you personalise your profile and, later, contribute.

Today your profile, later your contributions: you guarantee that you have the right to publish this content.

Not allowed: illegal, hateful, defamatory, misleading or advertising content, other people's personal data, and malicious links.

The team may moderate or remove content, and suspend an account in case of abuse.

Each dataset remains subject to **its source's licence**, shown on its page. Respect it when you reuse the data.

- **GeoAlgeria** data (Yasser's studio) must be credited.
- Data from **OpenStreetMap** is under the [ODbL](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/) licence: credit “© OpenStreetMap contributors” and share derived databases under the same terms.

The website's code is under the **MIT** licence: [github.com/new-algeria/data-dz](https://github.com/new-algeria/data-dz).

The data is provided **“as is”**, with no guarantee of accuracy, completeness or freshness.

For any important use (financial, legal, medical, administrative), check with the official source.
New Algeria cannot be held responsible for decisions made based on the data, nor for any unavailability of the service.
No deliberate overloading of the website or files (for example mass automated downloads), and no attempt to bypass security.

An error in the data, abusive content or just a question: write to [newalgeria.org@gmail.com](mailto:newalgeria.org@gmail.com).

For GeoAlgeria data, you can also use the “Report an error” link on the dataset page.
These terms may change. The update date shown at the top of the page is authoritative.
These terms are governed by French law.
